impact: A strong ANT debut supports the AI trade and GOOGL (a backer and placement buyer) and MSFT; the huge share supply could pull money from other AI names like NBIS and MU.
summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above the $70-78 range, and per CNBC upsized to about 980 million shares, raising about $81.3B, the largest offering on record. A concurrent $26B non-voting private placement to partners including Google and Nvidia lifts the total above $94B; Fortune puts the valuation at about $1.5 trillion. Trading starts Thursday on Nasdaq as ANT. Some reports had no final share count, implying at least $68.5B raised.
title: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83, above range; raises about $81B
